page: Amazon Web Services c9g.24xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance powered by custom AWS Graviton processors. Built on the arm64 architecture, this instance features 96 physical cores and 96 virtual CPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The CPU allocation is fully dedicated with a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio, meaning hyperthreading is not utilized. The instance is provisioned with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance operates on the AWS Nitro hypervisor. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 50 Gbps. The instance does not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the arm64 architecture and dedicated core configuration offer high compute density per resource unit compared to traditional x86 architectures. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes this instance profile appropriate for compute-bound workloads. Suitable applications include distributed analytics, batch processing, web serving, video encoding, and containerized microservices that require high CPU allocation without massive memory footprints.
